description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion)], Legacy +2 and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Water abilities, grants [Dual Critical Edge 60% Critical (15s)]/[Dual Critical Edge 80% Critical (15s)]/[Dual Critical Edge 100% Critical (15s)] to all allies if the user has Legacy level 2/1/0 after using two Water abilities, causes Legacy -1 after using two Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Lion)], grants Focus +1 if 4+ FF11 allies are alive, removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Lion)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Water abilities, grants [Dual Critical Edge 60% Critical (15s)]/[Dual Critical Edge 80% Critical (15s)]/[Dual Critical Edge 100% Critical (15s)] to all allies if the user has Legacy level 2/1/0 after using Water abilities, grants [Weakness +9% Boost 1]/[Weakness +15% Boost 1]/[Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using Water abilities if the user has Legacy level 2/1/0 and Focus level 1, causes Legacy -1 after using Water abilities

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost 1

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
